# Recordio

> Recordio is a cloud-based screen recorder for teams making product walkthroughs and demos. It runs as a Chrome extension (also Edge and Brave) with a web app at https://app.recordio.io, so it works on macOS, Windows, Linux and ChromeOS. An account is required; a free account is enough to start.

Website: https://recordio.io
Web app: https://app.recordio.io
Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/recordio-beautiful-screen/bbcdpipjplklaneplfmlhhibnllhinii
Contact: john@recordio.io

## What it does

- Auto zoom that reads the page DOM and frames the input, card or menu you interact with. Every zoom is an editable keyframe.
- Auto spotlight: 3D elevation of the element you interact with.
- Smart AutoCut: silence removal that keeps typing and clicking pauses.
- Simplified toolbar that hides bookmarks, tabs and extensions from the recording.
- Blur sensitive regions, webcam bubble, device frames (MacBook Pro and Air), backgrounds and a music library.
- AI captions with word-level timing. Captions are editable; deleting a caption line cuts that segment (Pro).
- Exports at 480p, 720p and 1080p on Free; 2K and 4K on Pro. Cloud rendering on Pro, browser rendering on Free.
- Share links with view analytics (view counts, watch time) and a public watch page (Pro).
- Team workspace with roles, collaboration and a shared team library. Unlimited viewer seats (Pro).
- Screenshots: capture the visible area, full page or a region, annotate in the web app, then copy, download PNG or PDF, or share a link.

## Pricing (per seat)

- Free: $0, no card required. Up to 5 active projects, videos expire after 7 days, 1080p downloads, lightweight local transcription, browser rendering.
- Pro: $12 per seat per month billed annually, or $15 per seat per month billed monthly. 4K export, captions, share links, team library, unlimited viewer seats, cloud rendering, unlimited projects, no expiry, 30-day restore.
